Insert a single narrow surface-binding rule after C8: bind a finite verb (including auxiliaries/copulas) with an immediately following complement that begins with a numeral, '(', a listed preposition, or a capitalized token — to prevent splits of predicate + required complement.
Replace E1 with labeled example en_us_44 to teach the predicate+numeral/measure attachment failure (high gap, ≤3 latency).
Replace E2 with labeled example en_us_1650 to show verb/copula + location complement splits (high gap, ≤3 latency).
Replace E3 with labeled example en_us_733 to illustrate parenthetical/named-location units that must travel with the verb/copula (≤3 latency).
Replace E4 with labeled example en_us_375 to show predicate + weight/measurement complement splits (≤5 latency).

delete C2 — remove a broad, restating principle that overlaps specific attachment-protecting rules so the prompt can concentrate on concrete, testable bindings (responding to the critique that predicate–complement protection needs focused rules and to the 'prune' constraint).
